hypothesis: New field images improve bean rust transfer beyond scheduling the same number of repeat master rust images.
intervention: 348 Makerere publisher-training bean rust originals versus 348 seeded draws from the 76 frozen training bean rust rows. Both use the full original training split, identical 177-label mapping, training-only original normalization and randomly initialized residual CNN.
checkpoint_selection: Original master 177-class validation macro F1, then validation loss within 1e-6, then earlier epoch.
comparison: Use eight-view probability averaging for both best checkpoints. Primary metric is fixed master validation macro F1 across 177 labels. Compare Tanzania expansion rust top-1 recall beside counts of cross-crop mistakes using all 177 outputs. Keep the original Tanzania 24-file preflight separate because its predictions informed source selection.
decision: A qualifying result merits a second matched seed and adequate-budget confirmation with a more complete independent bean collection. Single-source rust recall says nothing about specificity against unsupported conditions. Both eight-epoch pilots are ineligible for deployment. Leave course test and reserved confirmations sealed. Skip a second seed if either arm fails the declared guard.
